headline: Sensex slips as Nifty gains; Smallcaps and Metals shine amid Fed anticipation
why: US Treasury yields rose, weighing on global investor sentiment
AAII survey shows investor sentiment hitting a 16-month low
IT sector dragged indices down ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting
Metals and FMCG sectors outperformed, providing support to the Nifty
whatHappening: Sensex ended marginally lower by 22 points while Nifty gained 53 points
Smallcap stocks jumped nearly 1.8% despite volatility in large-cap indices
SBI reports potential ₹5 trillion notional profit for banks from FCNR(B)
Air India considers merging its budget unit to optimize operational costs

summary:
Indian markets showed mixed performance as the Sensex dipped slightly while Nifty and smallcaps gained ground.
Investor caution prevails due to rising US Treasury yields and a significant drop in global sentiment.
Sectoral rotation is evident with Metals and FMCG leading gains while IT remains under pressure.
